content: Worqqafe Oosettida Mara Misle

Musey zumaappe wodhdhontta keehi gam7idayssa be7idi asay Aaroone yuushon shiiqidi, «Ane Haa ya; neni nuna kaaleththiza eeqa xoossata nuus medhdha. Gibxe biittaafe nuna kessida Musey gidikko izi waanidaakko nu erokko!» gida.
Histtiin Aarooney isttas, «Intte machcheta hayththan, intte attuma nayta hayththaninne macca nayta hayththan diza worqqaa kessidi taas ha ekki yiite» gides.
Hessafe guye asay wuri ba hayththa worqqaa kessidi Aaroones ehides.

Izi hessa istta kusheppe ekkidi taman seerisidaappe guye qoxxiza miishshan qoxxidi mara misle medhdhides. Hessafe guye asaykka, «Isra7eele asawu! Nuna Gibxe biittafe kessida nu xoossati haytantta» gides
Aarooney hessa be7idi mara misleza sinththan yarshizaso giigsidi, «Wonto GODAAS ba7aale gallas gidana» gi awajjides.

Hessa gishshas wonteththa gallas asay wonttara dendidi xuugettiza yarshotanne issifeteththa yarshota yarshides. Histtidi asay maanaassinne uyanaas uttides. Mi uyi simmidi qasse duranaassinne guppanaas dendides.
Histtiin GODAY Muses, «Ne Gibxeppe kessa ehida ne asay nagara ooththidi banateththaa tunisida gishshas eeson duge wodhdha.

Tani istta azazida ogeppe istti eeson sher7i giichchida. Worqqa seerisidayssa mara misatissidi, baas eeqa xoossata medhdhidi izas goynnidanne yarshida. Qasseka, ‹Isra7eele asawu! Nuna Gibxe biittafe kessida nu xoossati haytantta› gida.
«Tani ha asaa beyadis; istti bantta wozina muumida asa.
Ha7i ta hanqoy istta bolla eexxi keziin tani istta dhayssanayssa neni tana diggofa. Hessafe qasse ta nena gita kawoteth histtana» gides.
Gido attiin Musey GODAA ba Xoossaa, «Abeet Godoo! Neni ne gita wolqqaninne ne mino qesen Gibxeppe kessada ehida ne asaa bolla hessaththo aazas hanqettay?
Gibxe asay, ‹Izi istta zumata bollan wodhanaassinne biittafe pitti dhayssanaas iita qofan kessides› ays geetettay? Neni ne wolqqama hanqofe simma; asaa dhayssanaas qoppidayssa agga.

Ne aylleta Abrahaame, Yisaaqanne Yaaqoobe qoppa; neni isttas, ‹Tani intte zereth salo xoolintte mala darsana; tani inttes immana gida biittaa ubbaaka intte zereththatas immana; istti he biittaa mernaas laattana› gaada neni ne sunththan caaqqida qaalaa yuushsha qoppa» giidi gaannatides.
Hessa gishshas GODAY ba asaa bolla iita miish ehanaas qoppidayssa aggides.
Hessafe guye Musey zumaa bollafe duge wodhdhishe tammu azazoti istta bolla nam7u baggara xaafetti uttida nam7u maseththa shuchchata ba kushen oykki ekki yides.
He masettida shuchchata giigsiday Xoossa; shuchchata bolla woocidi xaafidaykka Xoossa.
Iyaasoy asay wocamizayssa siyidi Muses, «Asay dizason ola waasoy siyettees» gides.
Museykka zaaridi, «Tani siyizayssi hayssi yeththafe attiin, olan xoonidayta qaala woykko xoonettidayta qaala deenna» gides.
Musey derezi dizaso matishe mara misleza sinththan asay durishininne guppishin be7idi keehi hanqettidi masettida shuchchata zuma garsan bollafe yeggidi menththereththides.
Asay medhdhida maraakka ekkidi taman xuuggides; hessafe guye liiqisi gaacci haaththan maadhidi Isra7eele asay uyana mala ooththides.
Hessafe guye, Musey Aaroone, «Ha asay nena wosttiin neni istta hayssa mala gita nagara ooththana mala kaaleththadii?» gides.
Aarooneykka zaaridi, «Ta godoo, hanqettofa! Hayssi asay iita ooththanaas ay mala koyzaakko ne eraasa.
Istti tana, ‹Nuna kaaleththiza eeqa xoossata nuus medhdha. Ays giikko nuna Gibxeppe kessi ehida Musey izi waanidaakko nu erokko!› gida.
Histtiin tani isttas, ‹Intte bolla diza worqqaa kessidi hammite› gadis; hessafe guye istti taas immida worqqaa tani taman yeggiin hayssi maray kezides» gides.
Aarooney asaa la7a yeddi aggiin asay ba morkketa sinththan kawuyidi kadhettanayssa Musey be7ides.
Hessa gishshas Musey asay dunkaanidi dizaso geliza pengen eqqidi, «GODAA bagga gidida asi oonikka taakko ha yo!» giin Lewe qommoti wuri izakko shiiqida.

Hessafe guye izi isttas, «GODAA Isra7eele Xoossay, ‹Asay wuri ba giththa mashsha ba xeessan xeessan gixxidi asay dunkaanidason gaxappe gaxa gakkanaas, asaa giddon yaanne haa simerettidi ba isha, ba laggenne ba shooro wodho› » gides.
Lewe qommoti Musey azazida mala ooththida; he gallas asaappe heedzdzu shii gidiza asi hayqqides.
Hessafe guye Musey Lewe qommota, «Hach intte GODAAS dummatideta; ays giikko intte intte naytanne intte ishata wodhanaas azazettidi wodhdhideta; hach GODAY inttena anjjides» gides.
Isra7eele Asaa Gishshas Muse Woosa
Wonteththa gallas Musey asaa, «Intte gita nagara ooththideta shin ha7i tani GODAAKKO pude zumaa bolla kezana; ta intte nagara atto giissanaakko oonee erizay» gides.
Histtiin Musey GODAAKKO simmi biidi, «Hayssi asay gita nagara ooththides; istti baas worqqafe eeqa xoos medhdhida.
Gido attiin Abeet Godoo! Ha7i istta nagara atto ga; akkay giikko neni xaafida mazgabaappe ta sunththaa qucca digga» gides.
Histtiin GODAY zaaridi Muses, «Tani ta mazgabaappe ta bolla nagara ooththida asata sunththaa quccana.
Ha7i baada ha asaa tani nees yootida soo kaaleththa; ta kiitanchchayka nena kaaleththana; gido attiin qaxxayana wodey gakkishin istta nagaraa gishshas ta istta qaxxayana» gides.
Aarooney worqqafe mara misle medhdhana mala asay iza waayisida gishshassinne izi medhdhida gishshas GODAY istta bolla bosha yeddides.
